title: Lifetime License
source_file: View Policy LICN-027_ Lifetime License _ NC State Board of Education.html

blocks.text: This Policy establishes the qualifications and procedures for obtaining a lifetime license.
An applicant may request that the Department of Public Instruction convert a continuing professional license to a lifetime license if the applicant holds a current CPL and has either:
30 or more years of creditable service with the North Carolina Teachers’ and State Employees’ Retirement System; or
blocks.label: (a)

blocks.text: 30 or more years of combined experience as a licensed teacher, administrator, or student services personnel employed in one or more North Carolina PSUs.
blocks.label: (b)

blocks.text: An applicant for a lifetime license is not required to complete continuing education credits for the renewal period immediately preceding the date upon which DPI converts the CPL to a lifetime license, provided the applicant meets all other qualifications for the lifetime license. Nothing in this Policy shall be construed to prohibit a PSU from requiring the holder of a lifetime license to complete continuing education or other professional development activities as a condition of employment.
A lifetime license shall remain effective for the duration of the licensee’s natural life unless the license is suspended or revoked in accordance with LICN-007.
